basics.name: Alan Zheng
basics.label: Cloud & Platform Engineer · Technical Consultant
basics.summary: Software and platform engineer based in Eindhoven. Most recently Technical Consultant at Philips Image Processing & Solutions via Enter B.V., working on cloud security, platform modernisation and CI/CD in a regulated healthcare environment (PDLM/QMS). Builds with AWS, Azure and Tencent Cloud, Python, and agentic-AI tooling including MCP servers. Bilingual English/Mandarin, with cross-border EU–China experience.

work.name: Enter B.V. | Philips IP&S, AM&D
work.summary: Cloud security, platform modernisation, and stakeholder delivery in a regulated healthcare enterprise.
highlights: Designed and deployed the platform's first AWS WAF using IaC: DDoS mitigation, IP filtering, OWASP Top 10 defences, and automated rule updates.
Built AWS-native observability behind the WAF — CloudWatch logging, metrics and alerting for the security signal.
Led the Vital Viewer project from concept to stakeholder demo, building front-end prototypes for key stakeholders.
Refactored the Health Analytics Engine and authored PDLM/QMS-compliant design documentation.
Set up the BDD environment used in the Health Analytics Engine's verification and validation process, and introduced it to the V&V team.
Led migration of a legacy field-study system to a modern platform and optimised CI/CD pipelines for stable releases.
Drove adoption of agentic development workflows (Claude, MCP servers, GitHub Copilot) among senior colleagues, cutting delivery time.

work.name: Philips IP&S
work.summary: Medical-data availability tooling for BATDOK in low-connectivity environments.
highlights: Enhanced BATDOK through IPFS integration, improving EMR availability in low-connectivity environments.
Developed an Android plugin using Kotlin–Go integration for peer-to-peer medical data sharing.
Conducted technical feasibility analysis and security assessment for military-grade systems.

work.name: Jinan Minhao Trading Co., Ltd
work.summary: Enterprise digitalisation for a 100-employee trading business.
highlights: Architected and implemented a WeCom (WeChat Work) platform, setting up OA workflows and integrating digital tools with business operations via platform APIs.
Drove business efficiency through digital solutions, optimising workflows and streamlining day-to-day operations.

volunteer.summary: Coordinated cross-team initiatives, managed a 150k+ budget, and facilitated stakeholder communication. Built the association's Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environment from scratch — identity and user management, email and collaboration, MFA and access policies.

projects.name: IND Sponsor MCP
projects.description: An MCP server that exposes the Dutch IND recognised-sponsor register to AI agents, so an assistant can answer "is this employer a recognised sponsor?" against the live register instead of guessing.

projects.name: Offline-capable medical records for BATDOK
projects.description: Extended BATDOK so electronic medical records stay available where the network doesn't: IPFS-backed peer-to-peer sharing via an Android plugin bridging Kotlin and Go over JNI, with a feasibility and security assessment for military-grade deployment. Philips IP&S.

projects.name: AWS WAF and observability for a Philips platform
projects.description: The platform's first WAF, delivered as infrastructure-as-code: OWASP Top 10 rules, IP filtering, DDoS mitigation and automated rule updates, with CloudWatch logging and alerting for the security signal. Enterprise work — no public code.

projects.name: Self-hosted n8n on Fly.io
projects.description: Deployment automation for a self-hosted n8n instance on Fly.io — reproducible automation infrastructure you own, rather than a SaaS tier.
